**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (fallback cure inserted).**

- **Investigation:** Article XXI (Effect of Termination, p0138) is one-directional — our licences end and we must ship back all Licensed Technology, API Documentation and Confidential Information within 5 days with an officer's certificate. Article XX (change-of-control termination), Article XXIII, and General Provisions (p0144–p0160) contain no exit, migration, data-return, export or deletion mechanics; searches for transition/assistance/data return returned nothing responsive. The planner's suspicion was correct: only Licensor-facing return of Licensed Software exists, which does not satisfy this rule.
- **Direction check:** the existing return obligation benefits Licensor, so it was not flagged; the gap is the absence of any reciprocal obligation on Licensor for a hosted platform holding our data.
- **Cure:** a single `insert_after` p0138 adding one short article carrying exactly the three fallback elements — assistance triggered on expiry or termination, at least 90 days of it, and export of our data within 30 days. Preferred-only items (six months at then-current rates, certified deletion) were deliberately omitted to keep the change minimal and avoid volunteering the paid-rate mechanic.
